messages.content: Choose exactly one frozen method for this research benchmark partition BEFORE seeing any association labels, held-out metrics or other partition outcomes. Call submit_partition_choice once. Use only the supplied expression-feature summary and method definitions. If the summary is insufficient, still choose one method and state the uncertainty. Do not claim efficacy or unseen performance.

{"dataset": "TRANSCRIPT v2.0.0 disease partition", "disease_count": 31, "drug_count": 613, "expression_gene_count": 12096, "median_disease_signature_sd": 0.00828, "methods": {"B0p": "Training-fold positive association count per drug", "B1": "Label-free negative Spearman correlation between drug and disease expression", "B1k": "Training-fold label propagation from expression-similar drugs with 10 neighbors", "B2": "Fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of B0p, B1k and B1 with k=60"}, "metric_to_optimize": "official NS-AUC", "partition_id": "transcript_disease_partition_04", "split": "random_simple", "split_description": "Hold out 20% of drug-disease pairs; the same drugs may occur in training"}

function.name: submit_partition_choice
function.arguments: {"method": "B1k", "reason": "Insufficient information to compare methods empirically before labels are revealed, but the summary suggests key considerations: B0p is purely a training-fold positive-count prior and, under a random_simple 20% pair holdout where the same drugs recur in training, it can leak drug-level frequency structure and give limited use of the provided 12,096-gene expression features. B1 (negative Spearman correlation) uses expression but is a single deterministic score and ignores the drug-disease association-count structure. B2 fuses everything but with fixed equal weights and no tuning evidence, adding complexity risk. B1k (label propagation from expression-similar drugs, 10 neighbors) uses the expression feature summary, incorporates training-fold association structure, is label-free at scoring time, and is a single coherent choice appropriate for a 613-drug / 31-disease space. Given only the provided summary, B1k is selected, with uncertainty noted about its superiority over B1 or B2 since no association labels or held-out metrics were available."}
